GSE144024 Single-cell RNA-seq QC Report

Datasets: FL, YS, hESC Day0 and hESC Day6.

QC metrics

Cell-level quality-control metrics were reconstructed directly from gene-by-cell UMI count matrices.

  • nUMI: total UMI counts per cell
  • nGene: number of genes detected per cell
  • pct_mt: percentage of mitochondrial UMI counts
  • pct_ribo: percentage of ribosomal UMI counts
  • genes_per_UMI: simple library complexity indicator

QC distributions

Interpretation

Low nUMI / nGene
May indicate low-complexity or low-quality cells.

High mitochondrial percentage
May indicate stressed, dying, or damaged cells.

Very high nUMI / nGene
May represent biologically RNA-rich cells, but can also indicate doublets or multiplets.

Important: The dashed thresholds shown in the plots are reference values only. They are not automatically used to remove cells. FL, YS, hESC Day0 and hESC Day6 may require different QC thresholds.
